input.title: Unisex Anime – That's Not a Wave. It's a No. Hoodie
input.descriptionHtml:
The Story

This funny anime hoodie is for the fan whose lucky-cat attitude says no before anyone asks, and wears it to conventions, crowded group chats and every plan they plan to skip.

A grumpy lucky cat with one paw raised, a red collar and a gold bell sits beside a single coin. THAT'S NOT A WAVE. runs above in heavy letters and IT'S A NO. below.

Pull it on for cold walks, comic shop runs and any invitation you are already declining. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed to order.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex fit, pullover with a double-lined hood and matching drawcord
  • 50% pre-shrunk cotton, 50% polyester
  • Fabric weight: 8.0 oz/yd²
  • Air-jet spun yarn with a soft feel
  • Front pouch pocket, ribbed cuffs and waistband with spandex
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • Colors: Sand, Navy
  • Blank product sourced from Bangladesh, Nicaragua, Honduras or El Salvador

Questions

What colors does it come in?
The Unisex Anime That's Not a Wave It's a No hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. comes in Sand and Navy. On Sand the headline is printed in navy and the punch line in brick red, and on Navy both lines are cream and coral, so every word stays easy to read from across the room on either color.

Is it a good gift for an anime fan?
Yes. The Unisex Anime That's Not a Wave It's a No hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. hands any anime fan a deadpan lucky cat in an 8 oz 50/50 fleece that is warm for convention lines and late watch parties. Order by about December 8 for Christmas delivery, with free US shipping over $45.

How does the That's Not a Wave hoodie fit?
The Graphic Tees Co. That's Not a Wave hoodie is a classic unisex pullover cut in sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for a regular fit, or go up one size for a roomier fit over a long sleeve or a tee. The first size exchange is free.

How do I care for it?
Machine wash this Graphic Tees Co. hoodie cold, inside out, with similar colors, then tumble dry low. The 8 oz 50% cotton, 50% polyester fleece is pre-shrunk, and washing inside out keeps the printed lettering and the lucky cat looking sharp through every wash.

Where does the print sit?
The That's Not a Wave print sits across the chest above the front pouch pocket, with THAT'S NOT A WAVE. over the cat and IT'S A NO. beneath, so both lines read from across the room. The hood is double-lined with a matching drawcord for cold days.
